meta.description: 40 hand-written tasks for R&D question A (tool design). Each task has one correct tool and the arguments that must be present. Ids come from evals/datasets/dev_jobs.json. Scoring rules: strings compare case-insensitively after trimming whitespace and trailing punctuation, numbers compare with tolerance 0.01, booleans compare exactly with an absent dry_run meaning false, idempotency_key is scored on presence only (a string of at least 8 characters). Arguments not listed in 'args' are not scored.
